list.text: Yo, challenger!\nBugsy made this Gym. It's a huge nest of Bug-type Pokémon.
Bugsy's young, but he's a master of Bug-type Pokemon!
It's going to be though without my advice.
Let's see... Bug-type Pokémon don't like fire.
Flying-type moves are super effective, too.
Well done! That was a great clash of talented young Trainers!
With people like you, the future of Pokémon is bright!
Amy: Hey, are you challenging the Leader? No way!
Mimi: If you insist, we'll be your opponents.

lines: EndSpeech: Amy & May: Oh, goodness!

list.text: Amy: You're really strong!
Mimi: Our bug Pokémon lost! Oh, what a shame.
If you move the web with the switch, you'll be able to figure out where the lift is going.
Just being in this Gym, I feel like I've turned into a bug Pokémon!
Bug Pokémon evolve young. So they get stronger that much faster.
If you want to meet the Gym Leader, you have to move the web using the switch.
\f[bugsy]Bugsy: \bI'm Bugsy!\nI never lose when it comes to Bug-type Pokémon.
\f[bugsy]\bMy research is going to make me the authority on Bug-type Pokémon!
\f[bugsy]\bLet me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.

lines: EndSpeech: Aw, that's the end of it...

then.text: \f[bugsy]Bugsy: \bWhoa, amazing!\nYou're an expert on Pokémon!
\f[bugsy]\bMy research isn't complete yet.\nOK, you win. Take this Badge.
\PN received the Hive Badge from Bugsy!
\f[bugsy]\bDo you know the benefits of the Hive Badge?
\f[bugsy]\bIf you have it, Pokémon up to Lv. 30 will obey you, even traded ones.
\f[bugsy]\bYou'll receive the Cut License too.
\f[bugsy]\bWith this special permit, your Pokémon are allowed to use the skill Cut outside of battle.
\f[bugsy]\bHere, I also want you to have this.
\f[bugsy]\bTM 89 contains U-Turn.
\f[bugsy]\bIt lets your Pokémon attack, then switch with the next Pokémon in your party.
\f[bugsy]\bIsn't that great?

list.text: \f[bugsy]Bugsy:\b Bug-type Pokémon are deep. \nThere are many mysteries to explore.
\f[bugsy]\bStudy your top choices thoroughly.

then.text: \f[bugsy]\bIt's fine if we take a photo together?!

list.text: \f[bugsy]Bugsy:\b Good to see you again!
\f[bugsy]\bOh, you came at just the right time!\nI'm not doing anything right now.\nWanna battle again?

then.text: \f[bugsy]\bYou must have studied a lot about Pokémon!
\f[bugsy]\bPlease take this.
\f[bugsy]\bThis is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Bug-type moves to Z-Moves.
\f[bugsy]\bWish you good luck!

branches.text: \f[bugsy]\bOh, come back when you feel ready.
